title: Depth bound for the recursive learner
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let a node finder for $k$-juntas on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube be given, let $f$ be a Boolean function on that cube taking values in $\{\pm1\}$, and fix a learning parameter $\varepsilon\in(0,1/2]$. For any fuel $r$, set $P$ of fixed coordinates, and assignment of signs on $P$, every supported outcome of the recursive learner that returns a decision tree has a tree of depth at most $r$.
